allow: PowerShell($body = '{"full_name":"Test User","email":"testuser_smoke@example.com","password":"Test1234!"}'; try { $r = Invoke-RestMethod -Uri "http://localhost:3000/api/v1/auth/register" -Method POST -ContentType "application/json" -Body $body; $r | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 } catch { $_.ErrorDetails.Message })

PowerShell($pids = netstat -ano | Select-String ":3000\\s" | ForEach-Object { \($_ -split '\\s+'\)[-1] } | Sort-Object -Unique; Write-Host "PIDs on 3000: $pids"; foreach \($p in $pids\) { try { Stop-Process -Id \([int]$p\) -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Write-Host "Killed $p" } catch { Write-Host "Skip $p" } })

PowerShell(Get-Process -Id \(Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.ParentProcessId -eq \(Get-Process pnpm -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Select-Object -First 1 -ExpandProperty Id\) } | Select-Object -ExpandProperty ProcessId\) -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)
